markoto.name: markoto
markoto.description: The signature look. Fraunces editorial headings, Inter body on plain white paper, vermillion accent — calm field guide, not dashboard.

modern.name: Modern
modern.description: Clean Inter sans-serif with a blue accent. The neutral starting point.

academic.name: Academic Paper
academic.description: Two-column Source Serif body, page numbers in the running head, minimal table borders — journal-style.

tech.name: Tech Report
tech.description: Compact IBM Plex Sans, cyan brand color, dark code blocks, brand-colored table headers with zebra rows.

business.name: Business Report
business.description: Playfair headings over Source Sans body, warm amber accent, brand-colored table headers, centered title.

novel.name: Novel
novel.description: Crimson Text serif for long-form reading. No code blocks, plain blockquotes, just a page number in the footer.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.description: Karla body under PT Serif headings, green accent, brand-colored table headers — weekly-digest feel.

delete.confirmBody: We'll keep your data for 30 days in case you change your mind. After that, everything is permanently removed. This action cannot be undone after the grace period ends.

delete.emailConfirmSubject: Your markoto account is scheduled for deletion

consequences.title: Here's exactly what will happen
consequences.intro: We want you to see the full picture before you confirm. Everything below runs automatically once the 30-day grace window ends.

deleted.heading: Permanently deleted
deleted.ownedDocs: No documents you own. | {count} document you own, including one you share with collaborators. They lose access at the same time. | {count} documents you own, including any you share with collaborators. They lose access at the same time.

deleted.exports: {count} previous data export and its ZIP file. | {count} previous data exports and their ZIP files.
deleted.stripe: Your Stripe customer record (Stripe retains underlying invoices for the period required by tax law).

anonymised.heading: Kept on the platform with your name removed
anonymised.comments: {count} comment you wrote on documents you don't own, shown as "[deleted user]". The text stays so others can still follow the conversation. | {count} comments you wrote on documents you don't own, shown as "[deleted user]". The text stays so others can still follow the conversation.

cascadeDelete.title: Will be cascade-deleted (sole member)
cascadeDelete.body: These workspaces will be permanently removed along with every document and knowledge file inside. If you want to preserve their contents, invite a co-member with admin role first, then come back and request deletion.
cascadeDelete.fileCount: no knowledge files | {count} knowledge file | {count} knowledge files

promote.title: Will get a new admin (other members exist)
promote.body: These workspaces stay live for the remaining members. An admin who joined before the others takes over; if there is no other admin, the longest-standing member becomes one.

removeMember.title: You'll just be removed
removeMember.body: Workspaces where you're an editor or viewer continue without you.

manualSteps.heading: Steps you may want to take first
manualSteps.exportFirst: Use the data export feature to download everything we hold about you as a ZIP — keep that file regardless of what happens here.
manualSteps.transferDocs: For any document you want a collaborator to keep, either move it to a workspace they own or have them duplicate it.
manualSteps.inviteWorkspaceMember: For any workspace you want to preserve, invite at least one admin-role collaborator before deleting.
manualSteps.downloadKnowledge: For knowledge-base files you want preserved, download them outside markoto first.

consequences.timing: The actual cascade runs as a background job once per hour. After the grace window ends, your data is fully purged within about an hour.
consequences.noRecovery: Once the cascade runs, your account and content are gone permanently — there is no recovery path.

delete.cancelledToast: Deletion cancelled. Your account stays as it is.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: Your account, the data we hold about you, and the controls for managing both.

spending.heading: Spending and usage
spending.comingSoon: Coming soon — your AI credit usage, plan history, and invoices will live here. For now, manage billing from the Pricing page.

data.heading: Your data
data.exportTitle: Download a copy of your data
data.exportDescription: We'll prepare a ZIP with everything we hold about you — your account profile, every document you own as Markdown, comments you've authored, billing history, AI usage logs, audit and consent records. The build runs in the background, usually under a minute. This page refreshes when it's ready, and we'll also email you a download link. The link is valid for 7 days.
data.exportInProgress: Export in progress — this page refreshes when it's ready.

delete.heading: Delete your account
delete.description: We'll keep your data for 30 days in case you change your mind. After that, everything is permanently removed — documents, comments, workspace memberships, billing history. Workspaces where you're the only member are cascade-deleted; workspaces with co-members get a new admin automatically.

legal.heading: Legal
legal.subheading: Versions of the Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Data Processing Addendum you have accepted. If we update any document materially, you'll see "needs re-acceptance" here and we re-prompt before any further action.
legal.dpaNotApplicable: Required when you create a workspace
legal.cookieNote: markoto uses only essential cookies: your sign-in session, your language, and a key that lets your browser delete documents it created without an account. There is no analytics, tracking or advertising, so there is nothing to consent to. The privacy policy lists every cookie.

sessions.heading: Sessions
sessions.description: Signed in on a device you no longer use, or worried someone else has access? Sign out of markoto in every browser and on every device, including this one.

storage.heading: Storage
storage.description: Images you upload or generate in your documents, including copies made when you duplicate a document. Images that no document uses any more are cleaned up automatically after a while.

billing.comingSoonHint: Paid plans with higher limits are coming soon.

aiProvider.intro: Bring your own key: connect your own OpenAI-compatible AI provider for each feature. Your provider account pays for these calls. markoto stores the key encrypted and never shows it again.

chat.description: Required for every AI feature: the prompt bar, {'@'}markoto in comments and web-search summaries. The model must support tool calling.

transcription.title: Voice transcription
transcription.description: Optional. Turns on the voice prompt. A Mistral key also turns on live dictation.

hero.title: Beautifully rendered {markdown}.
hero.body: A collaborative Markdown editor with a live, paginated preview. Write plain text; export a PDF that matches the preview page for page.

write.label: Editor
write.title: Write Markdown, get paged documents.
write.body: Type on the left; the right side lays it out as real A4 or Letter pages as you go.

rich.label: Layout
rich.title: Headers, footers and page numbers.
rich.body: Set them once in the theme. Tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams, math and footnotes render on the page too.

themes.label: Themes
themes.title: Change the look, not the Markdown.
themes.body: Pick one of seven themes, then adjust colours, fonts and the cover page. Your text stays untouched.

collab.label: Collaboration
collab.title: Edit the same document at the same time.
collab.body: Live cursors, comments and {'@'}mentions. Changes sync instantly: no save button, no merge conflicts.

ai.label: AI
ai.title: An AI assistant that edits your Markdown.
ai.body: Ask it to draft a section or fix a table. It writes into the document while you watch, and every change shows up in the history.

knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.title: Answers from your own files.
knowledge.body: Upload PDFs, Word or Excel files to a workspace. The AI answers from them instead of guessing.

history.label: History
history.title: Every change, with a diff.
history.body: See who changed what, people and the AI alike, and restore an earlier version in one click.

share.label: Share & export
share.title: Share a link or export a PDF.
share.body: Open, view-only or password-protected links. The PDF matches the preview page for page.

yours.label: Self-hosting
yours.title: Source-available and self-hostable.
yours.body: Run it on your own server with one script, or use markoto.app, hosted in the EU. Bring your own AI key.

cta.title: Try it with your own Markdown.
cta.body: Free on markoto.app, no sign-up needed — or host it yourself.

alt.hero: The markoto editor with a quarterly report: Markdown on the left, all its laid-out pages side by side on the right.
alt.write: The executive summary of a quarterly report typed in Markdown while its page renders live, then the preview pulls back to show the whole report.
alt.rich: A running header and a footer with the date and page numbers are added in the theme panel and appear on every page.
alt.themes: A different preset restyles the report, then a new accent colour, a new heading font and a designed cover page.
alt.collab: Three people in one report: two colleagues type in different sections, the author comments and mentions one of them, who replies.
alt.ai: From a title alone, the AI writes an executive summary with a table of key figures into the report.
alt.knowledge: A memo is uploaded to the knowledge panel and processed, then the AI answers from it, quoting its figures.
alt.history: The activity log with edits by several people and the AI; one edit opened as a diff, then restored.
alt.share: The share dialog with the document link, its QR code and who may open it.
alt.sharePdf: Pages of the exported PDF fanned out: the cover, the summary and a page with a chart.
alt.yours: AI provider settings: the writing assistant connected to the user’s own provider and verified.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: What the keys do in markoto's editor.

write.title: Markdown left, pages right
write.body: Type in the editor; the preview shows the pages exactly as they print and export. These buttons switch between editor, both, and preview.

format.title: Format without the syntax
format.body: Headings, lists, tables, alerts, math and diagrams. Select text first to format it.

theme.title: Make it look right
theme.body: Fonts, colours, page size, header, footer and the cover page live in the document theme.

share.title: Share the link
share.body: The lock decides who can open the link: only you, anyone to view, anyone to edit, or with a password.

ai.title: Ask markoto
ai.body: Describe what you want. The AI edits the document like a collaborator, and you watch it type.

help.title: Help is here
help.body: The documentation, the keyboard shortcuts and this tour are in the Help menu.

writeMobile.title: Write, then look at the pages
writeMobile.body: Type markdown here. The eye shows the pages as they print and export.

formatMobile.title: Format and insert
formatMobile.body: The Editor tab has headings, lists, tables, alerts, math and diagrams.

helpMobile.title: Help is in the menu
helpMobile.body: The documentation and this tour are in the menu.
